status: Verified offline private-cloud configuration prepared for authorized publication on main; hosted deployment not performed.

linux_cold_start_smoke.environment: Ubuntu WSL / Python 3.12.3; not Community Cloud Debian
linux_cold_start_smoke.memory_scope: API thread, Streamlit imports, model/index initialization and offline requests; not a full hosted container limit test.
linux_cold_start_smoke.model_bootstrap: Real pinned Hugging Face download and FAISS build in a fresh temporary cache.

security_and_preservation.scope: Exact current tracked/staged blobs, including the packaged binary; actual local credential values and common key patterns. Not a full historical secret audit.

necessary_binary.purpose: Existing trained pipeline needed for offline startup; verified against manifest.

model_artifact.benchmark_hash_format: File bytes with CRLF normalized to LF for cross-platform Git checkouts.
model_artifact.origin: Byte-for-byte copy of the existing locally trained public-data pipeline. No retraining.

limitations: No Community Cloud deployment, privacy setting, invite flow or platform resource allocation has been tested.
Linux tests used Ubuntu WSL, not the managed Debian image.
681.5 MiB Linux cold-start peak may exceed the lowest published memory allocation; hosted memory remains a trial gate.
Live Gemini is deliberately unsupported by this cloud entry point; no paid quota or billing status was inspected.
Private viewing requires platform sharing configuration. The loopback token is internal authentication, not viewer authentication.
Full Windows suite includes the 20 cloud tests; separate Linux execution is a repeat of that subset, not 20 new scenarios.
Four upstream warnings on Windows and seven on Linux were non-failing.
cross_platform_benchmark_fingerprint: Verified with LF and CRLF file bytes on Windows and Linux; original benchmark preserved.

initial_regression.cause: Logging test parsed a malformed line in the shared development log; concurrent check processes also wrote to that file.

publication_verification.fix: Pytest log handlers isolated per test in temporary directories. Runtime logging unchanged. Final checks run sequentially.
